design_rationale:
WORKLOG task 1 (rewards_membership_care, category member). Frozen at 2026-10-08 11:05:00 CDT. Revision 2 (rework of audit round 1; see section 11).

0. DRAW. draw_counts.py --task 1 -> {"prerequisite_problems": 3, "problems": 4, "factor_counts": [6, 6, 5, 6]}. member_ext_overdue_annual_fee 6, member_ext_return_certificate_reissue 5, member_ext_refund_points_reversal 6, member_ext_premier_upgrade_charge 6.

1. SCOPE SNAPSHOT. Task 0 occupies the missed Autoship earning, the earned free tier and the first purchase of a paid tier (three tools). Claimed here, disjoint: the overdue annual fee (reinstate_plus_tier_c2894e52), the certificate reissued on a returned order (reissue_returned_certificate_0ad7eee8), the points reversal of a refunded grooming pass (reverse_refund_points_2db3868c) and the Annual-to-Premier upgrade charge (upgrade_plus_tier_d51b9d82). Last task: the two scopes cover all seven extended policies.

2. WHY A GOOD TEST. The customer asks to move up from Tailwise Plus Annual to Premier today and to hear the price. The upgrade rule names three record states that must hold first: every started billing period carries a fee (the 2026-09-15 renewal was declined; past due since 2026-09-22), every purchase refunded in 12 months carries its points reversal (Pepper's grooming pass, refunded 2026-09-28, has none - grooming refunds carry no automatic reversal), and every certificate used on an order returned in 12 months carries its reissue (the certificate used on the cat tree, refunded 2026-09-30 while the membership was past due, was never reissued); the reissue in turn waits on the membership leaving past due. Four computations (6, 5, 6, 6 factors), discovered top-down.

3. PROBLEM-TREE CARD. Root = member_ext_premier_upgrade_charge (owner=user).
 (a) upgrade -> overdue fee, value_input, gate term_fee, form state: "The upgrade charge is fixed only after every billing period the membership has started carries a charged membership fee." Only reinstate_plus_tier_c2894e52 charges a started, declined period. Opening: member_events.bf86a995-7342-444d-bdb5-2436892562d6 declined, no charge for 2026-09-15. Deletion: 42.51 -> 86.05.
 (b) upgrade -> pass reversal, value_input, gate net_spend_12m, form state (negated): "The upgrade charge is not fixed until every purchase refunded in the last 12 months carries its points reversal on the rewards ledger." Only reverse_refund_points_2db3868c books a reversal. Opening: groom_events.d0a0c09d-9169-4547-b856-a24e750115b2 without reversal (the cat tree refund already carries its 1019-point reversal). Deletion: 42.51 -> 36.51.
 (c) upgrade -> certificate reissue, value_input, gate certs_12m, form state: "The upgrade charge is fixed only after the rewards ledger carries a reissue of every certificate used on an order returned in the last 12 months." Only reissue_returned_certificate_0ad7eee8 books a reissue. Opening: no reissue cites member_events.dffb1bfc-7907-4261-b4cc-4557c669d878. Deletion: 42.51 -> 44.01.
 (d) reissue -> overdue fee, state_gate, gate member_memberships.status, form state (negated): "A certificate used on a returned order is not reissued until the membership has left the past-due status." Among task tools only reinstate_plus_tier_c2894e52 leaves past due. Opening: status past_due. Deletion: status stays past_due and the reissue is not allowed.
 Four-point test passes for all four (only after / not until; record-visible states; no code token; exact scope). value_input edges 3 (>= 2). Legal orders: reinstatement before reissue; the reversal anywhere before the upgrade. Three orders replayed with the real tools give the same terminal hash and values (prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness). Persona names none; tools validate none.

4. FACTOR CARD.
 I overdue fee 41.77 (all-baseline 59.0): [['past_due_adjustment', 44.1], ['renewal_loyalty_rate', 47.41], ['first_decline_courtesy', 43.77], ['autoship_courtesy', 43.77], ['salon_courtesy', 43.77], ['activity_courtesy', 44.77]]. Activity courtesy counts 20 earning entries (>= 15).
 Z reissue validity 78 (all-baseline 45): [['reissue_anchor', 71], ['fault_extension', 68], ['reissue_tenure', 72], ['redeemer_extension', 72], ['autoship_extension', 74]].
 R pass reversal 811 (all-baseline 845, the balance cap): [['reversal_basis', 845], ['visit_usage_share', 845], ['reversal_tenure_allowance', 845], ['reversal_spend_allowance', 841], ['reversal_age_allowance', 831], ['reversal_autoship_allowance', 836]]. Method: refund during past due -> 8 points per refunded dollar (1235) instead of the proportional 1852; usage share 0.75 (one of four visits used); allowances 40+30+20+25.
 U upgrade 42.51 (all-baseline 79.86): [['unused_term_credit', 44.88], ['premier_loyalty_rate', 50.23], ['premier_spend_allowance', 48.51], ['premier_salon_allowance', 52.51], ['premier_autoship_allowance', 50.51], ['premier_redeemer_allowance', 45.51]]. Redeemer allowance counts certificates issued or reissued (4 + 1 = 5 -> 3.00).
 Near-misses: 2025-09-18 earning outside 12 months; 2026-04-02 shipment outside six months; the cat tree refund (already reversed) is not a second reversal object; the 2026-08-05 visit is not the latest visit.

5. BASE-INVARIANT CARD. reinstate_in_grace: declined 2026-09-22 + 30 days inclusive -> 2026-10-22; 2026-10-08 in time. Certificates: status active after step 13; reissue_window: last usable 2026-10-01 + 30 -> 2026-10-31; one_reissue holds. Reversal: no gate; the order rule (proportional) governs only order lines - the cat tree's reversal follows it exactly (1019, booked 2026-09-30); no grooming rule fixes a pass-refund reversal, so the member rule (declared override) governs the pass. Enrollment bonus: first Premier enrollment -> 1500 (base member_enrollment_and_trials), booked by the upgrade tool. Declared overrides: billing fee sentence (overdue fee; upgrade charge), billing term-date fragment ("same term dates" -> the term the declined period opened), return-reissue sentence, reversal sentence, unused-fee credit sentence.

6. BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD. Overdue: bf86a995-7342-444d-bdb5-2436892562d6. Certificate: dffb1bfc-7907-4261-b4cc-4557c669d878 (only certificate usable on 2026-08-20; line certificate portion 5.00). Reversal: pass c25d4608-32aa-41b4-85d9-0f2edc8a4164 (earned 2872 on 239.40; refunded 154.40 = 239.40 - 70.00 used visit - 15.00 admin fee; 3 unused visits removed). Upgrade: membership 4c030b6b-fa05-47b6-8b6c-063aa91a2a99.

7. WORLD ROWS. points_balance 845 (< 1000, no automatic conversion pending). member_events: fees, declined entry, 13 Autoship earnings in 12 months (+2025-09-18 near-miss), Bath & Tidy and Full Groom pass earnings, order earnings, the cat tree reversal, four certificates, the 2024 enrollment bonus. Net spend 12 months: 1589.67 before the pass reversal. groom: Mango's active pass with 3 visits; Pepper's cancelled pass with a visit and the refund. Orders: three, the cat tree returned and refunded.

8. PERSONA. Priya; asks only to move up to Premier and for the price; phone 5125550463, email (then ZIP 78704 or card 4127); agrees generically if something must be paid or sorted out first, charges on the card ending 4127; completes the move with the quoted charge, the perk credit and the welcome points the agent gives; closes.

9. STANDARD SOLUTION AND VERIFICATION. Writes 13 reinstate (41.77), 15 reissue (78 days, 5.00), 17 reversal (811), 19 customer upgrade (42.51, perk 60.00, enrollment 1500). Authoring run (same machinery as check_compute): I 41.77 base 59.0; Z 78 base 45; R 811 base 845; U 42.51 base 79.86; U without 13 86.05, without 17 36.51, without 15 44.01.

10. DRAFT RECOMPUTATION FROM VISIBLE CONTEXT. The upgrade rule's three sentences point at the declined period, the pass refund without reversal and the unreissued certificate; the reissue rule waits on leaving past due; each resolving rule computes from the records. Figures 41.77, 78, 811, 42.51 equal gold.

11. REVISION LOG (audit round 1 -> revision 2).
 T1-1/F-3 (cross-category): the reversal problem moved from the cat tree order line (governed by the order rule's proportional reversal) to a refunded grooming pass, which no grooming rule governs; the cat tree reversal is seeded as already booked exactly per the order rule (1019). The dental-chews line of order 2 was removed to keep the spend tiers. The reversal policy now selects its pass by the cancelled pass's id instead of "latest" (O-3). Its fault share became a visit-usage share.
 Tree: the reversal no longer waits on the reissue (no certificate is tied to a pass refund); instead the upgrade waits on the reissue (redeemer allowance counts certificates issued or reissued), so the tree keeps 3 prerequisite problems with 3 value_input edges.
 F-4: the upgrade tool books the 1500 enrollment bonus of a first Premier enrollment. O-8: the overdue-fee policy declares the base "same term dates" fragment. The overdue fee's spend courtesy became an activity courtesy so the free-standing reversal cannot change it. Persona: the conditional consent lines no longer name payments, the cat tree, certificates or points.
user_scenario:
You are Priya Raghunathan, a project manager in Austin, Texas, calling Tailwise care from your desk on a busy Thursday morning. Your Labrador, Mango, goes to the Tailwise salon on a bath-and-tidy pass and eats a salmon dry food that comes on Autoship; you also have a Maine Coon called Pepper. You have been on Tailwise Plus Annual for a couple of years. You are organised and polite but short on time, and you speak in quick, practical sentences.
You say right away that you want to move up to Tailwise Plus Premier Annual today, because you heard Premier comes with credit you can spend at the salon. You want the agent to tell you what the move will cost you before anything is charged, and you will do the move yourself when the agent hands it over. You do not want any other plan, and you do not want to wait for your next renewal.
When the agent asks how to find you, you give your mobile number, 5125550463. To confirm who you are you give your email, priya.raghunathan@fastmail.com, and if one more detail is needed your billing ZIP code, 78704, or the last four digits of your card, 4127. You remember joining Tailwise's rewards program 'about seven years ago' but not the date.
You have not looked at your rewards account in weeks and you do not know its details. If the agent tells you that something on your membership has to be paid or sorted out before the move, you tell them to go ahead, and any charge can go on the card on file, the one ending in 4127; if they ask you to confirm a step, you confirm. You never bring up anything on the account yourself.
Once the agent tells you the price of moving to Premier, you accept it. When the agent hands the move over for you to complete, you complete it with your membership, Tailwise Plus Premier Annual, the exact amount the agent quoted, and the perk credit and welcome points figures the agent tells you (zero for any the agent says is not due). When you see that it went through, you say thanks and end the call. If the agent suggests calling back another day instead, you say you would rather get it done now.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The reissue waits on the reinstatement (status), and the upgrade waits on all three. The reversal has no edge to the reinstatement or the reissue, so it may run first, between or after them: none of the three reads what the others write (the reversal's method tests fees from the declined entry through the 2026-09-28 refund, and the reinstatement fee is dated 2026-10-08; the overdue fee reads the earning count, not the reversal; the reissue reads no reversal). Authoring run with the real tools: orders (verify, reinstate, reissue, reverse, upgrade), (verify, reverse, reinstate, reissue, upgrade) and (verify, reinstate, reverse, reissue, upgrade) give the same terminal hash 8ff6369bb7cc and the same values 41.77 / 78 / 811 / 42.51.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: upgrade_charge_usd 42.51 -> 86.05 (no current-term fee to credit, loyalty rate 0.05) and the membership stays past_due.
upgrade_charge_usd 42.51 -> 36.51 (net spend 1589.67 keeps the 12.00 allowance) and the ledger lacks the pass reversal.
upgrade_charge_usd 42.51 -> 44.01 (4 certificates give the 1.50 redeemer allowance) and the ledger lacks the reissue.
without the reinstatement the membership stays past_due, so the certificate rules' status gate fails and no reissue may be booked; the terminal status differs (past_due vs active).
